title: WII CONSOLE, CONTROLLERS & GAM...
reason: Boxed Wii, boxed Wii Fit Plus and a Super Mario 25th Anniversary Edition set plus six games; sum of parts could be worth real money if complete and working.
findings: Photos show a boxed Wii console (box has a Wii Sports badge), a boxed Wii Fit Plus (balance board pack), a Mario Kart Wii wheel in retail packaging, a Super Mario All-Stars 25th Anniversary Edition red box (box face lists the Wii disc, history booklet and soundtrack CD), a loose white Wii Remote with lead, two silicone remote jackets, two battery packs and six game cases: Mario & Sonic at the London 2012 Olympic Games, Avatar: The Game (Ubisoft, PAL), Captain America Super Soldier (partly hidden), Wii Sports, Chicken Blaster and The House of the Dead: Overkill (Sega, MA15+, $10 off sticker). Australian classification labels on the cases. The catalogue title does not mention the original boxes or the Super Mario 25th Anniversary set, which is the most collectable piece. Box contents cannot be verified from the photos, and no sensor bar, power pack or AV lead is visible outside the boxes. Value is a judgement from the photos only, not price-checked.
condition: Not tested per catalogue. Boxes look clean with light edge wear; the Super Mario box has slight creasing at the lower edge. Discs, cables and the balance board are not shown.
rescore_note: Boxed Wii (Wii Sports pack), boxed Wii Fit Plus, Mario Kart wheel pack, boxed Super Mario All-Stars 25th Anniversary set and six games; sum of parts is solid if complete and working, but untested with leads and sensor bar unverified. Judged low end of $200 to $500 band. Not price-checked (search limit hit).
